tools.name: get_outage_overview
tools.description: Returns the current status of every UK broadband provider FindBroadband tracks (Down, Issues earlier or Working fine) in the outage hub's order, with the place where the provider named one, each affected provider's headline, the hub headline and a link to each provider's page. Down includes incident

tools.name: get_provider_outage_status
tools.description: Returns one UK broadband provider's outage status as its FindBroadband page shows it: the status and headline, current incidents and the latest past ones in the provider's own words with the places they named, a day by day picture of the last 30 days and links. status_based_on says whether the statu

tools.name: get_outage_history
tools.description: Returns the outage incidents each provider's FindBroadband page lists, for the last 30 days, a shorter window or one day: current first, then newest first, with start and end times, places and the provider's own words, plus a count per provider when no provider is given. Covers the last 30 days only

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_outage_overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
